description_en: Queries the authorization information about a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
description_zh: 查询云连接网实例的授权信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-grant-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --associated-ccn-id ccn-n2935s1mnwv8i00000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGrantRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the CCN instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: associated_ccn_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页展示的授权条目数。

默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的页码。

默认值是1
parameters.name: page_number

CcnInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the CCN instance

CcnUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CCN instance belongs
CcnUid.description_zh: 云连接网实例所属的账号ID

CenInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance

CenUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs
CenUid.description_zh: 云企业网实例所属的账号ID

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the permissions are granted

GmtModified.description_en: The timestamp when the permissions are modified
GmtModified.description_zh: 授权操作最近修改的时间戳

GrantRuleId.description_en: The ID of the authorization rule

GrantTrafficService.description_en:
Indicates whether the permissions to manage network traffic from the CCN instance are granted to a CEN instance that belongs to another account. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
GrantTrafficService.description_zh:
是否给跨账号的云企业网实例授权云连接网实例的流量服务能力。

true：已授权。
false：未不授权

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the CCN instance is deployed
RegionId.description_zh: 云连接网实例所属的地域ID

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页展示的授权条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
